name: neodev-rd-knowledge
description: Official NeoDev research and development knowledge workflow plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Guide NeoDev CLI workflows for docs, graph context, and Git checks.
interface.longDescription: Official workflow layer for NeoDev RD knowledge operations. It guides agents through version checks, DocChange registration, graph impact analysis, branch analysis, pre-push verification, and post-push refresh while keeping all state changes inside the NeoDev CLI.
